# clumio_gcs_protection_group (Data Source)

clumio_gcs_protection_group data source is used to retrieve details of a GCP protection group for use in other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clumio_gcs_protection_group" "example" {
  name = "my-gcp-protection-group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the GCP protection group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the GCP protection group.
